segments: What you didn't know about Evansville
Apartments right here in Crown Heights
is where the LA Dodgers, formerly known
as the Brooklyn Dodgers, play baseball.
The baseball team was called Dodgers,
but isn't the purpose of the game to
dodge baseball? The African Dodger was a
game played in America by many so-called
white people in country fairs and
festivals. In Luna Park, Coney Island,
less than 8 miles away from here, white
people used to throw baseballs at black
men's faces for fun. As says in Psalms
25 and 19, they hate us with cruel
